text:
Partly, yes. The JRC GFC2020 V4 map doesn't show the 2023 loss itself. It is a 2020 forest/non-forest reference map. What it does show is that the area later affected by the 2023 loss was forest in 2020. The agreement is 1.0, meaning 100% of the event area.

The loss itself comes from Hansen/UMD GFC (v1.13). It maps about 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2023, or 1.2% of the 58.1 ha asset. Later years were observed through 2025, which corroborates it. A further 0.4 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.

Context from the MGAP 2021 map: 0.4 ha was planted Eucalyptus, 0.3 ha was outside mapped forest, and none was native forest.

This does not establish deforestation or land-use change, since cutting a plantation also counts as loss. It also does not establish the cause, legality, responsibility, or any compliance finding.
